record_scope_reconstruction: Two distinct named facilities: Erez for passengers and Kerem Shalom for cargo; not a continuous Gaza perimeter closure.

source_checks.finding: OCHA describes both crossings closed after 25 March rocket incident with urgent humanitarian exceptions, and reopening 31 March.
31 March report independently names the Erez pedestrian and Kerem Shalom commercial terminals and their preceding Monday closure.
